entities.name: Donatus of Zadar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Donatus, also called Donato of Zara, was a Dalmatian saint who became a bishop and a diplomat for the Dalmatian city-state of Zadar (Zara). His feast day is celebrated on 25 February.
